title: Account recovery
text: In this fictional product, reset a forgotten password using the Reset password button on the sign-in screen. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. Support never asks for your password or a verification code.

title: Workspace invitations
text: In this fictional product, only a workspace owner can invite a teammate. Open Settings, then Members, then Invite. An invitation expires after seven days. Invited users do not receive billing access.

title: CSV export
text: In this fictional product, export a workspace from the Data page using Download CSV. An export contains synthetic tickets and their status. Spreadsheet formula prefixes are escaped before download.

title: Demo data retention
text: This portfolio demo accepts fictional data only. Anonymous demo workspaces expire after seven days. Clearing browser cookies loses access to a workspace. Do not enter customer records or personal information.

title: Webhook retries
text: In this fictional product, a webhook endpoint must reply with a 2xx response within five seconds. Failed deliveries retry after one, five and thirty minutes. Each delivery has an idempotency key to prevent duplicate processing.

title: Billing policy
text: The fictional Acorn Sandbox plan costs zero rupees. It never asks for a payment card and has no automatic upgrade. This is sample documentation, not a real product offer or a contract.

title: Integration credentials
text: In this fictional product, store integration secrets in a server-side secret manager. Never include an API key in browser JavaScript, a repository or an issue comment. Rotate an exposed secret through its issuing provider.

title: Status conflicts
text: In this fictional product, ticket updates include the version last read by the client. A stale version returns HTTP 409. Reload the current ticket before retrying rather than overwriting another editor.
